title: The orientation and theta factors and their intermediate coefficient comparison
statement: Fix a finite setting P, a positive quotient 1 ≤ m ≤ P.level, schemes X,Y over its field with Y separated finite type, and a separated finite-type f:X→Y. For a smooth f of relative dimension d and intrinsic K, define finitePurityInverseOrientation by applying intrinsic realization to identity on the fixed pullback of inverse-realized K tensored with the inverse specified diagonal orientation. For an etale presentation J,e of inverse-realized K define finitePurityTheta by realizing smoothPurityTheta at J,e. Define finiteReductionTensorOmegaComparison on the intermediate tensor M tensor omega by scalarPresentation, inverse binary tensorator of finiteTensorCore, then the tensor of the recorded pullback comparison followed by pullback of finiteReductionTensorInputComparison, with FiniteDiagonalReduction.omegaMap. This intermediate arrow uses no orientation, Tate-line isomorphism or purity map. The definitions used here are recorded in [def-pur-conventions], [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], [def-pur-finite-reduction-tensor-source], [def-pur-finite-tensor-fixed-comparisons], [def-pur-finite-diagonal-reduction-comparisons].
